'''Mukuda no Kuni no Miyatsuko''' (''umakuta no kuni no miyatsuko'', ''makuta no kuni no miyatsuko'', ''umakuta kokuzō'', ''makuta kokuzō'') was a {{ill|kuni no miyatsuko|ja|国造}} who ruled the central-western part of {{ill|Kazusa Province|cs|Provincie Kazusa|de|Provinz Kazusa|es|Provincia de Kazusa|fa|ولایت کازوسا|fr|Province de Kazusa|gl|Provincia de Kazusa|hak|Kazusa-koet|id|Provinsi Kazusa|it|Kazusa|ja|上総国|ko|가즈사국|lt|Kadzusos žemė|nl|Kazusa (provincie)|pt|Província de Kazusa|ru|Кадзуса (провинция)|simple|Kazusa Province|sk|Kazusa (provincia)|sr|Провинција Казуса|tr|Kazusa (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Кадзуса|zh|上總國|zh_classical|上總國|zh_min_nan|Kazusa-kok|zh_yue|上總國|qid=Q1055394}}.

== Overview ==

=== Ancestry ===
*The "Kokuzō Hongi" of the ''{{ill|Sendai Kuji Hongi|ar|كجيكي|fa|کوجیکی (سندای کوجی هونگی)|fr|Kujiki|id|Kujiki|it|Kujiki|ja|先代旧事本紀|ko|선대구사본기|pt|Kujiki|ru|Кудзики|uk|Кудзікі|vi|Cựu sự kỷ|zh|先代舊事本紀|qid=Q2716751}}'' states that the line begins when, during the reign of {{ill|Emperor Seimu|ar|الإمبراطور سيمو|arz|الامبراطور سيمو|azb|سیمو (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Seimu|cs|Seimu|de|Seimu|es|Seimu Tennō|fa|امپراتور سیمو|fi|Seimu|fr|Seimu|hr|Seimu|hu|Szeimu japán császár|id|Kaisar Seimu|it|Seimu|ja|成務天皇|ka|სეიმუ|ko|세이무 천황|nl|Seimu|pl|Seimu|pt|Seimu|ru|Император Сэйму|sh|Car Seimu|simple|Emperor Seimu|sl|Cesar Sejmu|sv|Seimu|th|จักรพรรดิเซมุ|tl|Emperador Seimu|tr|Seimu (imparator)|uk|Імператор Сейму|uz|Imperator Seimu|vi|Thiên hoàng Seimu|yo|Emperor Seimu|zh|成務天皇|zh_min_nan|Seimu Thian-hông|zh_yue|成務天皇|qid=Q316672|lt=Emperor Seimu}}, '''Fukakaoomi-no-Mikoto''', son of {{ill|Takekoro-no-Mikoto|ja|建許呂命|qid=Q11486843}} — descendant of {{ill|Amatsuhikone|ja|天津彦根命}} and ancestor of the {{ill|Ibaraki no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja|茨城国造}} — was appointed kuni no miyatsuko.

=== Clan ===
'''{{ill|Kashiwade-no-Ōtomobe clan|ja|膳大伴部氏}}''' (''kashiwade-no-ōtomobe-uji''; {{ill|kabane|ja|カバネ|lt=kabane}} unknown).

== Base ==

=== Territory ===
The kuni no miyatsuko's territory was the region then called '''Mukuda Province''', corresponding to the later '''{{ill|Mōda District|ja|望陀郡}}''' of {{ill|Kazusa Province|cs|Provincie Kazusa|de|Provinz Kazusa|es|Provincia de Kazusa|fa|ولایت کازوسا|fr|Province de Kazusa|gl|Provincia de Kazusa|hak|Kazusa-koet|id|Provinsi Kazusa|it|Kazusa|ja|上総国|ko|가즈사국|lt|Kadzusos žemė|nl|Kazusa (provincie)|pt|Província de Kazusa|ru|Кадзуса (провинция)|simple|Kazusa Province|sk|Kazusa (provincia)|sr|Провинција Казуса|tr|Kazusa (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Кадзуса|zh|上總國|zh_classical|上總國|zh_min_nan|Kazusa-kok|zh_yue|上總國|qid=Q1055394}} — all of present-day {{ill|Sodegaura|ja|袖ケ浦市}}, most of {{ill|Kisarazu|ja|木更津市}}, and parts of {{ill|Kimitsu, Chiba|ja|君津市}} and {{ill|Kamogawa, Chiba|ja|鴨川市}}. The {{ill|Gion-Nagasuga Kofun Cluster|ja|祇園・長須賀古墳群}} in Kisarazu in the lower {{ill|Obitsu River|ja|小櫃川}} basin, including the {{ill|Kinreizuka Kofun|ja|金鈴塚古墳}}, is thought to have been built by the Mukuda no Kuni no Miyatsuko.

== Tutelary Shrine ==
Unknown.

=== Tombs ===
*'''{{ill|Iigozuka Kofun|ja|飯籠塚古墳}}''' (''iigozuka kofun'')
*: A 102-m-long {{ill|keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳}} in {{ill|Kimitsu, Chiba|ja|君津市|lt=Kimitsu City}} in {{ill|Chiba Prefecture|ja|千葉県}}, thought to have been built in the {{ill|4th century|ja|4世紀}}.
*'''{{ill|Sengen Shrine Kofun|ja|箕輪浅間神社古墳|lt=Sengen Shrine Kofun}}''' (''sengen jinja kofun'')
*: A 105-m-long keyhole-shaped kofun in Kimitsu City, Chiba Prefecture, thought to have been built in the 4th century.
*'''{{ill|Hakusan Shrine Kofun (Kimitsu)|ja|白山神社古墳 (君津市)|lt=Hakusan Shrine Kofun}}''' (''hakusan jinja kofun'')
*: An 89-m-long keyhole-shaped kofun in Kimitsu City, Chiba Prefecture, thought to have been built in the 4th century.
*'''{{ill|Gion-Nagasuga Kofun Cluster|ja|祇園・長須賀古墳群}}''' (''gion-nagasuga kofungun'')
*: A kofun cluster in {{ill|Kisarazu|ja|木更津市}} in Chiba Prefecture, built from the middle of the {{ill|5th century|ja|5世紀}} to the {{ill|7th century|ja|7世紀}}.
